In [[mathematics]], the '''Brauer–Suzuki–Wall theorem''', [[mathematical proof|proved]] by {{harvtxt|Brauer|Suzuki|Wall|1958}}, characterizes the one-dimensional unimodular [[projective group]]s over [[finite field]]s.
